SOL keeps the memory of breathlessness and the realization that the Blood Lord is no longer beyond the clouds.

SOL preserves both the instinctive judgment and Taekyung’s experience fighting monsters.

SOL preserves the escalation beyond ordinary human limits.
SOL keeps the visible skin as evidence from which Taekyung infers what happened over the past year.

SOL uses the required ellipsis character and preserves the shocked reaction.

SOL uses the required ellipsis character and preserves the interrupted response.

decisions.replacement: A character in a pirate manga that still hasn’t ended once said a wound on the back was a swordsman’s shame. I’ve never agreed with that.
